validationAudit.notes: Initial pilot passed8/9; the failed fixture attempted to delete a CSS-connected font, which FontFaceSet.delete cannot remove. The corrected fixture loads an owned bundled-font face, asserts actual successful removal and verifies all-page export rejection before any native render. No application change was required for the font fixture. A later full production run passed120/121 and exposed changed single-page warning copy; the multipage capability report also still listed multipage output as omitted. Single-page copy is restored, the omission claim is removed, and behavior assertions were added. Final build, unit, native, production and compiled checks verify corrected report code; pre-fix source/reports remain retained. Actual documented host example and final closed-selection/new-tab/inactive-owner UI behavior are exercised by the final11-case multipage file. A stronger visual geometry probe then reproduced an off-screen Export/Cancel footer (footer bottom1026.875 in a1000px viewport). The scoped export modal now fixes its header/footer and scrolls its body. The shared UI workflow asserts viewport containment and unchanged footer geometry while scrolling; standalone light/dark checks also hit-test both buttons. A preliminary geometry probe serialization error is retained separately from the actual reproduced layout failure. Final full native/production and standalone checks use the corrected layout and identical frozen inputs. Failed/corrected reports and exact input hashes remain retained.
